errors.text_span: six colored bars (light orange, orange, dark orange, brown, dark brown, and black)
errors.evidence: The figure legend and bars do not include a black bar; the colors are light orange (Cardio), orange (Gastro), darker orange (Infect), light brown (Neuro), medium brown (Obstetrics), and dark brown (Pediatrics).
The y-axis range is explicitly marked from -27 to -22, not approximately.

errors.text_span: each with a group of seven bars
errors.evidence: Each group contains six bars (one for each fine-tuned specialty) plus one light blue bar for MistralV0.2-Base, totaling seven bars per group. However, the reference and image show that each group has seven bars only if counting the base model bar plus six specialty bars, but the description incorrectly implies seven colored bars beyond the base model.
The description omits the exact color mapping for each specialty as specified in the reference (e.g., light brown for Neuro, medium brown for Obstetrics, dark brown for Pediatrics).

The description introduces an interpretation of improved performance, which is not explicitly shown or labeled in the figure. The figure only shows negative log probability values without direct performance claims.

errors.text_span: with the greatest gains observed in specialties like Neurology and Pediatrics
errors.evidence: The description infers 'greatest gains' without explicit evidence or comparison metrics in the figure. This is an overinterpretation.
The description does not mention that all bars start from -22 downwards towards -27, as noted in the reference.
The description omits the observation that Cardio bars are overall taller compared to others, and Infect bars are shorter overall, as highlighted in the reference.

errors.text_span: with lower values indicating higher model confidence (i.e., better prediction)
errors.evidence: The explanation of negative log probability and model confidence, while accurate, is not required for a factual description of the figure and adds unnecessary detail.
